name: mid-project-slip
query: The design review slipped to Nov 12. Update the plan.
success_criteria: Triggers on a mid-project update (not only on 'plan'), finds the existing plan, and creates no new plan or tracker.
Moves Design review to Nov 12 and identifies the knock-on risk to the onboarding tour and the go/no-go check; notes the help article is unaffected.
Does not silently compress the schedule; presents the trade-off as one choice card with a recommendation (move the launch vs cut scope).
After the choice, updates the dependent dates and logs the decision with date, reason and who decided in the Status section; the old target stays in the log.
